page.overview:
Who is Ace Spencer?

Ace quit the gang when he discovered he was a mutant, and found work as a freelance security guard. Ace was sought by the NYPD and Spider-Man after witnessing a gang shooting by his brother, who had since joined the Reapers. Ace, confronted and fought by the superhero, was finally convinced of his responsibility to help others, and began by turning in his brother.

Ace saw "a lot" in the time after his last meeting with Spider-Man, and began working with Threadneedle for preservation of universes. While Ace was a key part of Threadneedle's plan to save the extradimensional entity Shan-K'ang, he never knew that the two were siblings.
